description.en: EComAgentBench evaluates LLM-based shopping agents on 662 long-horizon product selection tasks built from real Amazon data. Each task requires uncovering hidden requirements spread across an explicit query, tool-gated profile, and scripted clarification, verifying candidates, and committing to one product within 100 tool calls. Scoring uses typed, source-tagged rubrics for each requirement.

evidence.snippet: To address this gap, we introduce EComAgentBench, a benchmark of 662 tasks grounded in real Amazon products and reviews.

claire_radar.motivation: As LLM-based shopping agents enter production, existing benchmarks fail to capture how a shopper's requirements arrive: stated implicitly in the query, recorded in a profile, or revealed only when the right question is asked.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Existing shopping benchmarks reveal full intent upfront, failing to reflect real-world requirements that emerge over time. EComAgentBench measures agents' ability to handle long-horizon interactions, providing a reproducible foundation for comparing dependable shopping assistance.
